text: Do not use these library conversion or accumulation functions: `std::to_string`, `std::stoll`, `std::accumulate`, `sprintf`, `snprintf`, `std::stringstream`.

Compute each digit sum arithmetically: take the last digit with `% 10` and drop it with `/ 10`, in a loop or a recursion you wrote yourself. Reading the number as text (characters, a string or a character array) and adding up its characters does not satisfy this constraint.
